title: Looters at the gate
text: Three men with crowbars and a pickup truck are rattling the fence. One of them says they just want what's in the storeroom. {name} has a rifle up and is waiting for you.

success.text: The shot echoes down the block. The truck reverses and is gone.

fail.text: They rush the fence anyway. You drive them off, but they grab a box of food and someone takes a crowbar to the arm.

effects.text: You pass two boxes over the fence. They leave without a word. Nobody is proud of it.

title: A voice on the radio
text: Static, then a woman's voice: "...anyone... we're on the roof, there are kids with us, please..." She gives a street name before the signal drops.

effects.text: You circle the street on the map. They won't last long up there.
You click it off. The room is very quiet for a long time.

title: Horde passing
text: Hundreds of them are shuffling down the main road, drawn by a car alarm somewhere east. They will pass right by the walls.

success.text: Nobody breathes for an hour. The sound of feet fades west.

fail.text: A child cries out. A dozen of them peel off and tear at the barricade before you put them down.

choices.label: Draw them off with a truck
choices.hint: One volunteer, risky, keeps the walls safe

success.text: {name} floors it with the horn blaring and comes back two hours later, grinning and shaking.

fail.text: {name} drew them away. The truck never came back.

title: Strangers at the gate
text: A family of three is at the gate, exhausted. The father keeps his left arm behind his back.

success.text: It was a cut from a fence. They cry when the gate closes behind them.

fail.text: It's a bite. You let them in anyway, and now there is a decision to make.

effects.text: They walk away slowly. Nobody talks at dinner.

title: Abandoned ambulance
text: {name} spots an ambulance on its side two blocks out. The back doors are shut. Something might be moving inside.

success.text: Only the wind. {name} comes back with two full trauma bags.

fail.text: The driver was still strapped in. {name} gets away with a few supplies and a deep cut.

title: A trader
text: An old man with a cart and a shotgun waves a white rag. He has ammunition and wants food.

effects.text: He counts every can twice and leaves whistling.

title: Fever
text: One of the kids has a high fever. Not a bite, {name} is sure of it, but it isn't breaking.

effects.text: Two days later she is asking for food. People smile for the first time in a while.

success.text: The fever breaks on the third night.

fail.text: She doesn't wake up. You bury her by the fence.

title: Lone wanderer
text: A thin woman with a hunting bow walks up the road and stops at the wire. She says she can pull her weight.

success.text: She sleeps for fourteen hours, then goes straight to work.

fail.text: Three nights later she starts running a fever. There was a bite under her sleeve.

choices.label: Give her water and send her off

effects.text: She nods, drinks, and keeps walking.

title: Storm front
text: Black clouds roll in fast. The wind is already pulling at the tarps.

effects.text: Barrels fill to the brim. The wind takes a section of roofing.
Everything holds. You catch a little rain.

title: Blight in the beds
text: {name} shows you the leaves. Spots, spreading from plant to plant.

effects.text: You lose a week of food, but the rest of the crop is clean.

success.text: {name} treats the soil with ash. The crop recovers.

fail.text: It spreads through everything. Half the harvest rots.

title: Fight in the mess hall
text: {name} and {name2} are on the floor swinging. It started over a missing can of peaches.

effects.text: Full bellies cool tempers. They shake hands, sort of.

success.text: A week of cold nights together and they are friends again.

fail.text: The grudge spreads. People start picking sides.

title: A stray dog
text: A skinny shepherd mix has been circling the walls for two days. It growls at the dead, not at you.

effects.text: The kids name him Biscuit. He barks at anything that moves outside.
It watches you for a while, then trots off.

title: Fire in the storeroom
text: A lantern tipped over. Smoke is pouring out of the storeroom.

choices.label: Use the water to put it out

effects.text: You form a bucket line. The fire is out in ten minutes.

choices.label: Tear down the wall to stop it

effects.text: You lose part of the storeroom, but the fire doesn't spread.
